name: Account Identification Search Criteria 2 Choice
definition: Choice between the different options to search for an account.

Equal.name: Equal
Equal.definition: Search for one or more accounts based on exact identification of the account(s).

ContainText.name: Contain Text
ContainText.definition: Search for one or more accounts based on partial identification of the account(s).

NotContainText.name: Not Contain Text
NotContainText.definition: Search for one or more accounts based on a pattern that cannot be contained in the account identification.
